title: Erwin Leclere and the tune It's Too Late to Be Sorry
summary: A story about playing Leclere's tune for him, and Hug's recording of it.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: There's a fellow called Zimmerman, who is not related to Roy. He's supposed to have played Ragtime back around, Urban Laclaze time. Uh-huh. Did you ever know him, Tom or Tony? I can't remember.
Tony Parani, I think, said he worked with him.
Did you hear him? Erwin Leclerc?

I can't say that I ever remember hearing Erwin play, but I can tell you a funny story about Erwin. Erwin wrote quite a bit of nice tunes. I knew one tune called It's Too Late to Be Sorry. He wrote it with Joe Huertas. I don't think anybody ever played it. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc. Erwin Leclerc came in there and he knew me and I knew him, but he didn't know that I knew this tune and I started playing it for him. And you should have seen the expression on his face. He came up to me and says, my God. He says, I didn't know anybody ever played this tune anymore. He was so happy about it, he gave me a $5 tip.
I think you played it from the other one. It's a good tune.

It's a wonderful tune. In fact, I recorded it for Cosmo Matasson, Ace Label. I'm still waiting for that album to be released right now. You know, knowing Cosmo, I don't know when it'll be released, but he says that it will be released sometime. It's been two years now since I recorded it.
